step_by_step_reasoning: The visual architecture diagram displays a news distribution platform (NewsGrid). At the top, global USERS connect to Route 53 for DR routing, then hit ELB. ELB authenticates users via Cognito and routes traffic across EC2 instances in two Availability Zones. EC2 instances forward requests to AppSync. AppSync communicates directly with DynamoDB for primary data storage and sends real-time MQTT subscription updates back to Users. DynamoDB Streams trigger Lambda, which indexes and synchronizes data into Elasticsearch (OpenSearch).
